alerts.title: Wind Advisory
alerts.detail: Wind Advisory issued November 25 at 7:46PM EST until November 27 at 5:00AM EST by NWS Upton NY
alerts.body:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 20 to 25 mph with gusts up to 50 mph
expected.

* WHERE...In New Jersey, Western Passaic County. In New York, Orange
and Putnam Counties.

* WHEN...From 10 AM Thursday to 5 AM EST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* INSTRUCTIONS...Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

Secure outdoor objects.

alerts.title: Flood Advisory
alerts.detail: Flood Advisory issued November 24 at 4:29PM EST until November 27 at 1:15PM EST by NWS Upton NY
alerts.body:
* WHAT...Minor to locally moderate tidal flooding is expected around
the times of high tide from Thursday morning through Friday
morning.

* WHERE...The Hudson River in Westchester, Rockland, Orange, and
Putnam counties in southeastern New York.

* WHEN...Until 115 PM EST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Minor to locally moderate tidal flooding is expected
along the river around the times of high tide.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 416 PM EST, Water levels along the Hudson River will increase
to minor and locally moderate thresholds during the times of high
tide Thursday morning through Friday morning.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

* INSTRUCTIONS...Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.
